resources.string: Works offline · English, हिंदी, मराठी, Hinglish

Type or speak in English, हिंदी, मराठी or Hinglish. Answers about your gate, boarding, flight, bags and where things are in Terminal 2 come from the data saved on this phone, so they also work in airplane mode.
Try: “Mera gate kahan hai?” · “Majhi bag kuthe aahe?” · “When does boarding close?”
